source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(len(row) - 2):
            if row[c] == row[c + 2] and row[c + 1] != row[c]:
                out[r][c + 1] = 2
    return out
'''
task_file.write_text(source)
